partner.body: We are proud to be an official Shopify Partner — and since August 2026 you can find Drapit right in the Shopify App Store. One click and the virtual fitting room is live in your store, seamlessly integrated with your Shopify environment.
partner.featureAppStoreDesc: Live on the App Store — install Drapit in one click from your Shopify admin, no code.
partner.featureInstallDesc: Works with every theme and updates automatically. Prefer manual? The standalone widget remains available.
partner.techBody: Our own IDM-VTON architecture uses advanced diffusion models to photorealistically drape garments onto the customer’s body. Unlike simple overlays, Drapit understands texture, shadow and body shape.

items.a: Less than 10 minutes. Copy one script tag from your dashboard, paste it into the <head> of your store — Shopify, WooCommerce or custom — and the widget is live.

items.q: What if I reach my monthly limit?
items.a: The API declines new requests until the next month. You can always upgrade instantly from your dashboard to activate more try-ons.

Yes. Drapit has been live on the Shopify App Store since August 2026 — install in one click, no code. On a different platform? Drapit works on any store that supports custom scripts: WooCommerce, Magento or custom builds.

items.q: How does the AI work under the hood?
items.a: We use IDM-VTON, a state-of-the-art diffusion model specialized in virtual try-on. The customer uploads a photo, we process both images and deliver a realistic result within seconds.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Yes, you keep access until the end of your billing period. No hidden fees, no contracts.

contactSection.body: Have a question, want a demo, or curious whether Drapit fits your store? We usually respond within one business day.

finalCta.body: On Shopify you install in one click. On any other platform you create an account and place the widget yourself — same prices, no credit card required.
